black_ice.name: Black ICE
black_ice.description: Intrusion countermeasures: a wall of cold, patient code.
black_ice.battle_intro: The terminal frosts over. Something on the other side of the jack is watching.

kernel_sentinel.name: Kernel Sentinel
kernel_sentinel.description: A guard process. It does not shoot; it deals.
kernel_sentinel.battle_intro: The sentinel fans a hand of processes. "Credentials," it says, "or cards."
